raw_comment: Before looking at this graph I would assume areas that struggle with drought would be in the same geographical location such as being all land-locked states but to my surprise, I also noticed some coastal states struggle with drought. I wonder how coastal areas are experiencing drought despite their proximity to water. This relates to my community because live in a coastal area and was surprised to see that there is drought present in coastal areas which I had not previously noticed. In my AP Research class, I am studying marine abnormalities as a result of global warming and am curious to see if that is a leading cause of these droughts. A catchy headline for this graph would be, "Where's my water?"
